meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Codex 每成功执行一次代码编辑,就会触发注释检查;若注释被警告,Codex 会收到阻塞性提示,须先修复或解释该注释再继续。检查器缺失时不阻断正常流程。
howto.when: 当 Codex 用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑工具成功修改文件,且注释检查器对改动发出警告时,该技能介入处理。

say.text: 请修复刚才警告标记的那条注释。
say.note: Codex 会重新编辑该注释以消除警告。

say.text: 解释一下这条注释为何不符合规范。
say.note: Codex 会解释这条注释被警告的原因。

say.text: 保留该注释并说明理由。
say.note: Codex 会说明保留理由,然后继续。

howto.what_en: On each successful code edit, comment-checker runs; if it warns, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing. Missing checker binaries emit no output, so normal work continues.
howto.when_en: When Codex successfully modifies files with edit tools such as apply_patch, write, or edit, and the comment checker warns about the change, this skill intervenes.

say_en.text: Fix the comment flagged by that warning, please.
say_en.note: Codex will edit the comment to clear the warning.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment fails the checker.
say_en.note: Codex will explain why the comment was flagged.

say_en.text: Keep this comment and justify it.
say_en.note: Codex will justify keeping it, then proceed.
